Title: A Duel of Madness and Metamorphosis.

Messages.Author: Cameron
Messages.Body:
As the good sir t!MmY noted in his last 'zine, me and him have been having
quite a few games of V:TES over IRC. For those of you unfamiliar with the
concept of playing V:TES over a chat room, it goes down like this:
*Entirely based on honour.......for the moment ;)
*Just type what cards you play. Not as clunky as you might think.
*Due to people living all over the world (stupid timezones, whoever thought
that concept up should be shot), we have mainly been playing 2 player games.
I've managed to 'recruit' a few people into playing on a regular basis, and
have also pulled off a few 3 player game sucsesfully. The more the merrier,
though.

And without further delay, here is the transcript of a game me and t!MmY
played. (note: as my ego dictates, I must inform you that I had beaten him
several times before we played this game)

cool game transcript! i just wanted to point out two possible rule
mistakes (don't want to sound rude, i just point them out to help). also,
if i made a mistake with these rulings, please point them out (LSJ?).

><Mr_tiMmY> Back to close?
><mesh> yep, now blood of acid
><Mr_tiMmY> Hm...
><mesh> (should have done it the first time, fuckit)
><Mr_tiMmY> Okay, strike with hands for 2 strength.
><mesh> modding it with agg?
><Mr_tiMmY> Nope.
><mesh> good
><Mr_tiMmY> :)
><Mr_tiMmY> Your strike?
><mesh> I'll play rotschreck
><Mr_tiMmY> :p
><Mr_tiMmY> Wait, don't you have to attempt to *strike* with aggravated?
><mesh> it says *inflict*, not *strike*
><Mr_tiMmY> Well, that's ambivalent...
><Mr_tiMmY> I suppose you're "inflicting" aggravated...
><mesh> yep

here, Rotschreck cannot be played. the aggravated damage is not being
inflicted by the opposing minion, which is a condition for Rotschreck to
be playable (the damage from Blood of Acid is considered environmental).

><mesh> blood of acid
><Mr_tiMmY> Uh oh!
><Mr_tiMmY> Hm...
><Mr_tiMmY> Hm...
><Mr_tiMmY> Strike: Dodge (with a "Dodge")
><mesh> k
><Mr_tiMmY> No additional strike!
><mesh> *gasp*

i think that the Abomination's additional strike is mandatory... not 100%
sure with this one.

hey, i'll try to drop by once in a while to play via IRC.
